- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Stated that psychology training includes research methods and statistical analysis, which are useful in HR roles.

- [USER] User asked if companies value a psychology degree for HR positions or if they prefer technical backgrounds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Indicated that many organizations value the skills and perspectives of psychology graduates in HR roles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cited a survey from the Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM) showing that individuals with social science and humanities degrees, including psychology, make up a significant portion of HR professionals.
